state.comparisonWithPrevious: Prior study 2025-06 showed FEV1 71% predicted; interval decline

personas.name: restriction-ungraded-severity-moderate-no-action-flag
personas.description: Restrictive pattern present but the clinician left the `severity` field ungraded (empty) — this still computes abnormalitySeverity 'moderate' via the actionable-finding-without-graded-severity rule (R-SEV-MODERATE-02), but the abnormal-requiring-action flag does NOT fire, because flags.js checks the raw `severity === 'moderate'` input field rather than the computed output severity, and here the raw field is still ''. A real, verified discordance between Axis B's output and the flag set, distinct from the previous persona where severity was explicitly graded 'moderate'. The free-text reportingCategory field is also used verbatim since severity is unset.

state.clinicalHistory: Progressive exertional breathlessness, query interstitial lung disease
state.findingsNarrative: Reduced FVC with a preserved FEV1/FVC ratio, consistent with a restrictive ventilatory defect. Severity grading pending further volumes (TLC) not yet available.
state.impression: Restrictive ventilatory defect; formal ATS/ERS severity grading pending lung volumes.
state.reportingCategory: restrictive pattern, ATS/ERS grading pending TLC
state.recommendedFollowUp: Arrange full lung volumes (TLC) to complete severity grading; respiratory referral

expected.reportingCategory: restrictive pattern, ATS/ERS grading pending TLC

personas.name: reduced-gas-transfer-only-minor-discordant-category
personas.description: Isolated reduced gas transfer (low DLCO) with otherwise normal spirometry — classified abnormal via the dedicated reduced-gas-transfer rule (R-CLASS-ABNORMAL-02), a distinct path from the structured-finding branch since reducedGasTransfer is NOT one of hasAnyAbnormalFinding()'s own triggers. Severity grades minor. A second real discordance: because `airflowObstruction` is false and `severity`/`reportingCategory` are both left blank, reportingCategoryFor() falls through to its default and returns the literal string 'normal' even though the classification is 'abnormal' and severity is 'minor' — verified directly against reportingCategoryFor()'s source rather than assumed.

state.impression: Isolated reduced gas transfer with normal spirometry, possible chemotherapy-related diffusion defect.
state.recommendedFollowUp: Respiratory referral for further characterisation of the diffusion defect

personas.name: unmarked-interpretation-default-inconclusive
personas.description: A technically acceptable test where the reporting clinician recorded the raw measured values and a narrative but never explicitly ticked either 'normal spirometry' or any abnormal structured-finding box — a genuinely important, easy-to-miss default-state trap verified directly against classifyResult()'s source: because normalSpirometry defaults to false and stays false here, and no abnormal-finding box was ticked either, the study falls through every other branch to R-CLASS-INCONCLUSIVE-03 ('no structured finding was recorded and the study was not flagged as normal') and is classified inconclusive even though nothing about the measured values themselves is actually equivocal.
